mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mail_message ( sender_id, subject, content, sent_at, status, sender_deleted, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{senderId}, #{subject}, #{content}, #{sentAt}, #{status}, #{senderDeleted}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM mail_message m INNER JOIN mail_recipient r ON r.mail_id = m.id WHERE r.recipient_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted_flag = 0 AND r.spam_flag = 0

SELECT m.id AS mail_id, m.subject, m.content, sender.username AS sender_username, sender.nickname AS sender_nickname, recipient.username AS recipient_username, recipient.nickname AS recipient_nickname, m.sent_at, r.read_flag, COALESCE(a.priority, 'MEDIUM') AS priority, COALESCE(a.spam_flag, 0) AS spam_flag, COALESCE(a.spam_level, 'NONE') AS spam_level, COALESCE(a.risk_level, 'SAFE') AS risk_level, a.risk_reason, COALESCE(a.analysis_status, 'NOT_STARTED') AS analysis_status FROM mail_message m INNER JOIN mail_recipient r ON r.mail_id = m.id INNER JOIN sys_user sender ON sender.id = m.sender_id INNER JOIN sys_user recipient ON recipient.id = r.recipient_id LEFT JOIN mail_analysis a ON a.mail_id = m.id AND a.recipient_id = r.recipient_id WHERE r.recipient_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted_flag = 0 AND r.spam_flag = 0 ORDER BY m.sent_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM mail_message m WHERE m.sender_id = #{userId} AND m.sender_deleted = 0

SELECT m.id AS mail_id, m.subject, m.content, sender.username AS sender_username, sender.nickname AS sender_nickname, recipient.username AS recipient_username, recipient.nickname AS recipient_nickname, m.sent_at, NULL AS read_flag, COALESCE(a.priority, 'MEDIUM') AS priority, COALESCE(a.spam_flag, 0) AS spam_flag, COALESCE(a.spam_level, 'NONE') AS spam_level, COALESCE(a.risk_level, 'SAFE') AS risk_level, a.risk_reason, COALESCE(a.analysis_status, 'NOT_STARTED') AS analysis_status FROM mail_message m INNER JOIN mail_recipient r ON r.mail_id = m.id INNER JOIN sys_user sender ON sender.id = m.sender_id INNER JOIN sys_user recipient ON recipient.id = r.recipient_id LEFT JOIN mail_analysis a ON a.mail_id = m.id AND a.recipient_id = r.recipient_id WHERE m.sender_id = #{userId} AND m.sender_deleted = 0 ORDER BY m.sent_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT m.id AS mail_id, m.subject, m.content, m.sender_id, sender.username AS sender_username, sender.nickname AS sender_nickname, r.recipient_id, recipient.username AS recipient_username, recipient.nickname AS recipient_nickname, m.sent_at, m.sender_deleted, r.read_flag, r.read_at, r.deleted_flag, r.deleted_at, COALESCE(a.spam_flag, r.spam_flag, 0) AS spam_flag, COALESCE(a.analysis_status, 'NOT_STARTED') AS analysis_status, a.summary, COALESCE(a.spam_level, r.spam_level, 'NONE') AS spam_level, a.spam_reason, COALESCE(a.risk_level, r.risk_level, 'SAFE') AS risk_level, a.risk_reason, COALESCE(a.priority, 'MEDIUM') AS priority, a.priority_reason, a.reply_suggestions FROM mail_message m INNER JOIN mail_recipient r ON r.mail_id = m.id INNER JOIN sys_user sender ON sender.id = m.sender_id INNER JOIN sys_user recipient ON recipient.id = r.recipient_id LEFT JOIN mail_analysis a ON a.mail_id = m.id AND a.recipient_id = r.recipient_id WHERE m.id = #{mailId} LIMIT 1
